qualifier: PKA activation and phosphodiesterase cAMP breakdown
name: cAMP signalling via PKA activation and phosphodiesterase breakdown
rationale: All members concern cAMP production, PKA activation or cAMP termination; unlike the adenylate cyclase-inhibition and dopamine/CREB confusables, the theme carries PKA activation and PDE1-mediated cAMP catabolism.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members concern triglyceride/fatty acid balance and VLDL remodelling, with LXR (NR1H2/3) gene regulation distinguishing it from the lipid droplet and lipophagy confusables.

core: Two-pore domain potassium channels and resting potential
qualifier: inhibition of sodium and calcium influx
name: Two-pore K+ channel resting potential and cation-influx inhibition
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TREK, TASK, TWIK, THIK, TRESK) and resting-potential control; the negative regulation of Na+, Ca2+ and K+ fluxes is what the K+ channel confusables lack.

name: snRNA gene transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and major/minor splicing plus Pol II/III snRNA transcription, which separates it from RNA decay, Pol III tRNA and histone mRNA processing confusables.

name: Centrosome cycle, mitotic spindle and cytokinesis
rationale: Members concern centrosome/centriole duplication, spindle assembly and positioning, cilium disassembly and cytokinesis, whereas the confusables centre on chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodelling.

name: NGF-activated TRKA signalling cascades
rationale: All members are NGF/TRKA downstream signalling branches (FRS2, ARMS, PLCG1, ERK5, STAT3, CREB, retrograde), distinguishing it from NTRK3 and p75NTR confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF-MAPK signalling and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MAP2K/MAPK activation and ERK dephosphorylation feedback, which RAS/MRAS-activation confusables lack.

qualifier: SREBP sensing and lipoprotein receptor uptake
name: Sterol-sensing control of cholesterol synthesis and LDL receptor uptake
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol synthesis via SREBP and cholesterol uptake via LDLR/VLDLR, distinguishing it from generic receptor endocytosis and reverse cholesterol transport confusables.

name: NOD1/NOD2 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: All members concern NOD1/NOD2 responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide in antibacterial immunity, unlike fungal C-type lectin, TAK1 and IL-17 confusables.

name: Amyloid fibril formation and amyloid precursor protein turnover
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril formation and APP synthesis/breakdown (plus obsolete amide metabolism terms), whereas confusables centre on amyloid-beta clearance and glial responses.

name: Dietary disaccharide digestion and intestinal hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover dietary carbohydrate digestion, disaccharidase deficiency and hexose/fructose/glycoside transport; digestion and glycoside handling separate it from SLC transporter disease confusables.

qualifier: cell size control in activity-driven adaptation
name: Striated muscle growth and cell size in adaptation
rationale: Members regulate cell size, cardiac adaptation, sarcomere organization and skeletal muscle growth in response to activity, unlike atrophy and calcineurin-signalling confusables.

qualifier: fibronectin, elastic fibres and integrin interactions
name: Collagen, elastic and fibronectin matrix with integrin interactions
rationale: Members span collagen fibril, elastic fibre, fibronectin and basement membrane assembly plus integrin/DDR binding, which the collagen-biosynthesis and laminin confusables lack.

name: Hedgehog precursor autoprocessing and ligand release
rationale: Members concern Hedgehog self-cleavage, lipid modification, secretion and ERAD of mutants, distinguishing it from Notch glycosylation, RAS lipidation and Wnt biogenesis confusables.

qualifier: neurohormonal mating, parturition and parental behaviours
name: Neurohormonal control of reproductive and social behaviour
rationale: Members cover mating, erection, parturition, uterine contraction, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviours, distinguishing it from stress, sleep/orexin and exploratory behaviour confusables.

name: Tooth dentin and cementum formation and eruption
rationale: Members concern odontogenesis, odontoblast differentiation, dentinogenesis, cementum mineralization and eruption, unlike enamel/bone mineralization and ectodermal appendage confusables.

name: Leukocyte adhesion and T cell immunological synapse formation
rationale: Members cover leukocyte adhesion, migration and T cell polarity/synapse formation, which integrin-activation and CD28-Vav1 confusables lack in breadth.

qualifier: transcriptional and post-translational control in EMT
name: Cadherin expression control in epithelial-mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members regulate CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19 transcription, trafficking and degradation within EMT, whereas confusables concern adherens junction assembly itself.

name: Protein stability control with RHOBTB GTPase cycles
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization/destabilization and proteasomal catabolism together with RHOBTB1-3 cycles, which the deubiquitinase, neddylation and chaperone confusables lack.

name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism with storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycogen storage diseases, G6P transport, gluconeogenesis and glucokinase, distinguishing it from glycolysis and fructose metabolism confusables.

name: IL-6 signalling with ERK1/2 activation and dephosphorylation feedback
rationale: Members combine IL-6/JAK-STAT3 signalling with ERK1/2 activation and phosphatase-mediated MAPK feedback, unlike ERK-only and IL-27 confusables.

name: Branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members concern the BCKDH complex, its regulation by BCKDK/PPM1K and MSUD variants, distinct from downstream BCAA catabolism and organic aciduria confusables.

qualifier: hydroxylation, methylation and oxidation including collagen crosslinking
name: Protein hydroxylation, methylation and oxidation, including collagen crosslinking
rationale: Members are peptidyl hydroxylation, methylation and oxidation (including collagen crosslinking and arylsulfatase activation), unlike the translation-factor modification confusables (diphthamide, hypusine, selenocysteine).

qualifier: production, clearance and tau tangle regulation
name: Amyloid-beta production, clearance and neurofibrillary tangle regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta formation, clearance, cellular response and fibril/tangle assembly, distinguishing it from glial-activation and fibril-only confusables.

name: Adherens junction assembly and cadherin adhesion opposing EMT
rationale: Members cover adherens/apical junction assembly, cadherin adhesion, apical constriction and EMT suppression, unlike epithelial polarity, desmosome and cadherin-expression confusables.
